tools.name: check_flight
tools.description: Use when the user asks "does my flight have Starlink/WiFi?" with a specific tracked-airline flight number and date. Returns YES if the published aircraft assignment is a plane verified to have Starlink, LIKELY YES if that plane is listed as Starlink-equipped but not yet verified, NO if it is a plane

tools.name: get_fleet_stats
tools.description: Use when the user asks "how far along is the Starlink rollout?" or wants overall fleet numbers. Returns tracked airlines Starlink installation counts and percentages across mainline and express fleets, plus a per-aircraft-type breakdown (installed/total per family). Not for per-flight checks — use c

tools.name: list_starlink_aircraft
tools.description: Use when the user asks about the planes themselves — "which tail numbers have Starlink?", "which aircraft types are equipped?". Returns tracked airlines tail numbers, aircraft types, operators, and install dates (default 50 most recent; pass limit up to 500). Not for finding flights — use search_sta

tools.name: predict_flight_starlink
tools.description: Use when the user asks "will my flight have Starlink?" for a date too far out for a confirmed assignment, or with no date at all. tools.name: plan_starlink_itinerary
tools.description: Use when the user asks "what's the best way to fly X to Y with Starlink?". Compares Starlink odds on the route across every tracked airline (nonstop, per-carrier). For multi-stop UA routings, connect to unitedstarlinktracker.com/mcp.

tools.name: predict_route_starlink
tools.description: Use when the user asks "which flights between X and Y have Starlink?" or "what Starlink flights serve airport X?".
